Definition: Ezer, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ezer = "treasure"; 1) father of Hushah of the sons of Hur; 2) a Gadite chief who fought with David; 3) a Levite who aided in repairing the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
